statusNote.en: HashiCorp was acquired by IBM in 2025; Vault continues to be sold under the HashiCorp brand.

sources.title: HashiCorp Vault pricing page (Vault-specific tiers not rendered in fetch)
HCP Vault Dedicated tiers and features

limits.en: Vault Community edition is free and open source, self-hosted, with core secrets management, encryption and dynamic secrets features.

keyLimits.en: Free, self-managed, no official support SLA.

Hourly-billed managed cluster on HashiCorp Cloud Platform, no per-client fee; exact hourly rate not confirmed on an official page in this session (search results cite roughly $0.03 to $0.62/hour for an extra-small cluster).
Self-managed enterprise binary with advanced features (replication, Sentinel policies, HSM support); sold as a custom annual license, no public list price.

cautions.en: HCP Vault Dedicated production tiers (Essentials, Standard) reportedly add a per-authenticated-client monthly fee on top of the hourly cluster cost, which was not verified against an official HashiCorp page in this session and should be re-checked before quoting a figure.

capabilities.en: Centrally stores, accesses and distributes secrets programmatically to humans, machines and applications.
Certificate lifecycle management: generate, rotate and revoke certificates on demand.
Encryption-as-a-service for data in transit and at rest, plus automated secret rotation via API.
Identity-based authentication and authorization for humans, machines and services.

limitations.en: Community edition has no official support SLA and lacks enterprise features like performance replication and Sentinel policy-as-code.
No self-serve public pricing for Vault Enterprise; requires a sales quote, making budgeting difficult without contacting HashiCorp.

reason.en: Simpler, fully managed secrets management SaaS, easier onboarding for small teams.
Open-source secrets management alternative with a hosted option, positioned as a lighter-weight Vault competitor.

missingAlternatives.name: AWS Secrets Manager
missingAlternatives.reason: Major cloud-native secrets manager competitor, especially for teams already on AWS, not present in the candidate list.

unknowns: Exact hourly and per-client pricing for HCP Vault Dedicated tiers not confirmed from an official HashiCorp page (only third-party estimates found); needs direct verification.
Vault Enterprise list pricing is not public; only obtainable via sales quote.
